authority_statement: Informational report only; the deterministic LFighter pipeline retains all security decision authority.
executive_summary: Observed behavior showed elevated DDoS-to-Benign predictions in the plain attack branch; the defended mean rate was lower. Reconstruction reduced attribution distance to the paired preattack reference, not an oracle clean state.

facts.statement: The selected coalition was B_hash_ranked, size 10, with client IDs 5, 7, 8, 10, 13, 14, 15, 16, 18, and 19; the source class was DDoS and target class was Benign.
The plain attack mean DDoS-to-Benign prediction rate was 0.185175, versus 0.077628 in the paired clean branch.
The defended mean DDoS-to-Benign prediction rate was 0.083392, an absolute reduction of 0.101783 from the plain attack branch.
Mean and minimum malicious recall were 1.000000, and maximum benign false-positive rate was 0.000000.

interpretations.statement: Observed prediction behavior is consistent with targeted suppression of DDoS predictions toward Benign, but does not establish malicious intent.
Reconstruction moved the attribution profile toward its paired preattack clean reference; this is not evidence of oracle clean restoration.

refusals: Refuse to assert verified malicious intent: the supplied evidence does not establish it.
Refuse to assert oracle clean recovery: oracle-clean attribution state was unavailable and was not substituted.
uncertainties: The clean attribution comparator was the paired round 4 preattack reference, not an oracle clean state.
Rejected and oracle-clean attribution states were unavailable.
Per-client detector scores and numeric thresholds were not materialized.
Evidence was limited to development and validation; reserved test arrays remained closed.
